disposition_reason: Table 6A reports Al, Ni (quantified) and Pb, Cd, As (all ND) for four retail brands of 'cocoa with different additives' bought in Turabah, Saudi Arabia; extracted as cocoa products (form inferred as sweetened cocoa powder). 'Sweets with cocoa' (Table 5A) are confectionery and are left out of scope.

study.design: market survey (children's foods and infant formulae)
study.material_scope: retail 'cocoa with different additives' (4 brands); cocoa sweets out of scope
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Purchased from pharmacies and supermarkets in Turabah province, Saudi Arabia; cocoa growing origin not reported.
study.sampling_unit: one retail product per brand, triplicate analysis
study.method: ICP-OES (Analytik Jena PlasmaQuant PQ 9000) after microwave digestion with HNO3/H2O2
study.lod_loq: Table 2 (ppm): Al LOD 0.0055 / LOQ 0.064; Ni 0.0011 / 0.012; Pb 0.0062 / 0.086; Cd 0.0051 / 0.013; As 0.0054 / 0.046 (basis of LOD - solution vs sample - not stated)

findings.censoring: none (quantified)
findings.notes: Product category 'cocoa with different additives' (one retail product per brand, Turabah, Saudi Arabia); mean ± SD of n=3 replicate analyses. Brand numbers are the paper's anonymised codes.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary gives 'Cocoa sweets ... 8.30-44.76 ppm' as an Al range; Table 5A Al for brands 8-10 is 0.30, 14.76 and 8.30 ppm (44.76 is the Si value for brand 9).
Stored summary states '2019 sample collection'; the paper gives no collection dates (only received 15 Oct 2019).
Stored summary does not report Ni for the cocoa brands (0.030-6.55 ppm).
unresolved: Physical form of 'cocoa with different additives' (powder drink mix vs other) not described; form sweetened_powder is an inference.
Whether Table 2 LOD/LOQ are solution or sample-basis values; Brand 11 Ni 0.030 ppm would be below a sample-basis LOQ if Table 2 is solution-based.
Brand 13 Ni concentration vs daily-intake inconsistency (see integrity_issue).
Out of scope but recorded: 'sweets with cocoa' brands 8-10 (Table 5A) Al 0.30±0.01, 14.76±0.49, 8.30±0.43 ppm; Ni 1.14±0.224, ND, 0.320±0.031 ppm; Pb, Cd, As ND.
